text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaagh, seriously the absolute worst...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I messed up my nails... and I lost my homework, too...
My luck's been so trash lately... it's seriously such a downer...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Is this potato starch!?
I thought I ordered 10kg of wheat flour, though~~!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But but, I already told everyone
I'd bake a giant cake...
I gotta think of a substitute, quick~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... And after I planned so many things, too...
Hmph, I'm not talking to Papa anymore...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My, what gloomy expressions you have, my little ponies.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Since it's a rare day off, I'd really love to see our cute little pony-chans smiling.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Why don't you all stick around and watch a puppet show for a change of pace?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? Mmh... I'm not really in the mood for that right now...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Don't say that—just watch for a single moment. Look!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eh—
Wait, where did that little bunny come from...!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Come now, it's a precious Sunday after all.
Why don't we all throw a party together!

text_block_list.name: Bunny
text_block_list.text: "Even though I wanted to dress up nicely, the dress I ordered hasn't arrived!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—For you, I present this flower.
If you arrange it as a floral accessory, even your current dress will be wonderfully transformed.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: "We don't have enough ingredients to make the party cake! What should we do?!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—In that case, how about making a croquembouche with what we have?
Let's stack them up into a magnificent tower!

text_block_list.name: Dalmatian
text_block_list.text:
"Come on everyone, cheers!
Let's turn everything into happiness and have a whole lot of fun together~!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa.
Calling it a puppet show doesn't do it justice... It's like real magic...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Flowers... like, dried flower inlay nails? Totally viable! And if we party it up after, it's gonna be super lit, right? Sounds awesome...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: A croquembouche, huh... If we use potato starch... we might be able to do something similar with strawberry daifuku! Let's make it a totally buono party!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!! A party? Nice, nice~☆★☆★ Let's all do it together☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mayano, won't you join the party with us too? Let's see, first off—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wahh??

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Pop! Pop! Pop! Pop!*)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Sooo cool...! It's so gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Did you like it?
I know I can't compete with your dad, but... please let me make it up to you for today.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...! Ehehe... thank you.
I was feeling down because my plans with Dad were cancelled, but that totally cheered me up!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad. I hope you get another chance to go out with your dad soon.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Yup yup.
"Fuji Kiseki's" magic strikes again~☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai is amazing~!
The puppet show and these flowers were just like magic...!
Mayano wants to use magic like that too—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No, I'm gonna use it! After all, I already figured out how it works~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And now, and now, here goes~~!
One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa! Out of thin air, a rose has appeared!

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, awesome!
Isn't that a pretty difficult magic trick?
When did you even practice that~!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? Did it look difficult...?
Even though Fuji-senpai did it so effortlessly and smoothly...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
M-More! I can bring out more!
Let's see, one, two, three...
Huhhh? Mmmngh~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hyah! ......H-Huhhhh?
That wasn't smooth at all~~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Friend
text_block_list.text: No way, just being able to do it that well is already incredible~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I shouldn't be doing it wrong, so why does it look so hard?
I want it to look effortless! Smooth and graceful!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever! I'll just ask her directly!
Fuji-senpaai~! Are you there~~??

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
............
—Coming, just a moment!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mayano.
What's the matter? It's quite late at night.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Look! That flower magic trick you showed us the other day!
I wanted to ask you the trick to doing it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did you like it that much?
Let me think... The secret is to "captivate", perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Just like this.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(...! It really is incredible, but...
What's different? Neither the trick nor my sleight of hand should be wrong, so why...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—...Wait, huh?
Fuji-senpai, were you doing something?
Behind you there's a whole bunch of books and flowers—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My room is my secret base, so it's a secret.
—Now, Mayano, lights-out is approaching. Why don't you get some sleep for today? Along with that little one, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ! ...Okaay, good night.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh. Did she kind of dodge the question...?
What was that pile of books about...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(...Could it be magic practice...?
Does she practice so much that she can pull it off like real magic?)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...No, usually nobody would have that much time. There must definitely be some kind of trick to that magic—a secret "gimmick"...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpaai~~!
Show me the flower trick one more time!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Sure, I'll show you as many times as you like.
One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here you go!
A flower perfectly suited for your energetic smile today.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmm... Mmmh~~??
It's just a normal flower...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, let me check inside your clothes! You're definitely hiding some super crazy gadget in there, aren't you~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My, are you in detective mode today, Mayano?
Well then, feel free to investigate as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Inside the jacket—! ...Nothing.
Pants pockets—! ...Nothing at all!?
Whyyyy!?!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Taking a stroll♪ Strolling along♪ Marvelous☆★☆★
...Mayano-chan? Something on your mind~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmh... It's not really a worry, but there's just something I can't figure out at all~~...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It's about Fuji-senpai's magic—...Wait, Fuji-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...One, two, three.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I really need to increase the speed more. If I do that, the presentation will be even more dazzling...
One, two, three...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Does Fuji-senpai... ever make that kind of face...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Fufufu☆
This might be super rare footage~★☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpaai~~! Hey, don't tell me!
Do you always come out here to—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mayano. What a coincidence.
Today just happened to be... there's a delicious western confectionery shop nearby, so I was thinking of getting something for everyone—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
————Liar.
...Mayano figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(The secret to Fuji-senpai's magic...
This is it. Practicing relentlessly, drilling it into her body over and over and over...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Going that far is what finally turns it into magic.
Fuji-senpai, you're actually super—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Shh... that's enough.
If you see backstage, the magic will break.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Pop! Pop-pop-pop-pop-poooop—!*)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ah, waaaahhhhh~~!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha☆★☆★ As expected of Fuji!!
So many flowers and plushies☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wha-...! A-Amazing, so amazing!
Flowers and plushies at the exact same time!
And so many of them...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: How much practice did this take to—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: From here on out, it's a world of secrets.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Magic has no tricks or gimmicks, after all.
To produce a magical moment, you mustn't ever let backstage show.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Only when you captivate the audience completely can you grant them dreams and hope————

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So, will you keep what you just saw a secret for me? Little magician-in-training.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—! I see... I get it now!
Yeah, I'll definitely keep it a secret! And Mayano will surely become a magician just like you, Fuji-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading back first!
Time for some secret special training~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
————Here, a marvelous treat to share with Fuji☆
It's special mixed juice★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard, Fuji.
To make marvelous magic, taking breaks is super important too☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ————...Ahaha. You got me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But it's alright, I'm not overdoing it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The wonder—and the smiles—of everyone who experiences a magical moment. If I can achieve that, nothing could ever be considered "overdoing it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday, on the riverbed I happened to pass by.
It was a brief moment where I caught a glimpse of an entertainer's dedication.
